action: Execute Linda Park's direct outreach tactic: identify the risk or compliance team leads at both insurtech firms I applied to by name — using LinkedIn, company websites, and any application research I already have — and send each a brief, specific professional note. Not a job board message. Not a follow-up on my application. A direct professional introduction: who I am, what I know about regional autonomous vehicle disruption from lived field experience, and why risk management expertise is the gap insurtech companies are not filling fast enough as personal auto liability migrates to corporate fleet coverage. Close with a request for a 20-minute conversation. No deck. No portfolio link in the opener. One ask. I send both messages today.
